name: C4 protocol (base-seed variation, tkgl-polecat TiRGN)
authorised_by: lead message 2026-10-14 (C4 AUTHORISED on GPU 0 once G8's chain has released it)
status_of_test_data: no test number of the second TiRGN seed exists at registration; seed-43 base not yet trained

base.recipe: identical to the seed-42 run (hd_tirgn.py: L = 10, hr 0.3, lr 1e-3, <= 12 epochs, patience 3 on full-valid filtered MRR, max 7 training hours, valid-best checkpoint, harness top-200 dump; dec_chunk 4096 is an inference chunk size only)
base.host: <HOST> GPU 0 (after the G8 chain releases it)

pipeline: pilot-1 pc pipeline on base 'tirgn2' (pc_lists, hd_lookup exact base values, pc_features) with the code of tracks/pc_tirgn

HRCOV_PAT = v7 MLP64_PAT arm (25 features, W 100, masked listwise loss, calibrated fusion; seeds 0-2) and EV_NF_PT = v7 EV_PT arm (evidence features + is_extra flag, score alone), both from v7_btrain.py in one run, same fit/selection rows (valid sample, 70% timestamp cut)
controls: BASE(+)RecB blend and RecB-POOL selected on the valid grid only (hd_blend valid + hd_select), one official test pass (hd_blend test) for base, BLEND, POOL and the promoted lists

comparisons.primary: on the seed-43 base: HRCOV_PAT - better control (by test MRR between BLEND and POOL, as in v7), and HRCOV_PAT - BLEND (lead request)
comparisons.b3: on the seed-43 base: FULL - EV_NF_PT (B3 base contribution on the common PT pool)
comparisons.seed_variation: seed 43 - seed 42 per-query paired differences for: base MRR; HRCOV_PAT MRR; (HRCOV_PAT - BLEND); (HRCOV_PAT - POOL); (FULL - EV_NF_PT); seed-42 values from the v7 official files

statistics: as tois_v7_rule.json (paired Poisson query bootstrap + timestamp-block bootstrap, B = 2000, seed 0, shared draws; present iff one-sided L > 0 under both; exclusion only if ts U < 0.005); descriptive, no claim beyond the bounds
label: pre-specified later analysis (C4)
